how: Each flagged row re-opened on Google Maps (English UI) with its own map query and, where it has one, its local name; the place's address was compared with the row. 'Permanently closed' on this very place, or 'Temporarily closed' with no reopening date found → removed; a regular seasonal closure → kept with a note; a closed branch of a place open elsewhere or a namesake → kept. One or two web searches for each temporary closure. No town fell under its minimums, so nothing was added.
